rows.boss_readiness: 当前牌组Boss模拟胜率0%（原始0%）；输局1000例，Boss平均剩76%、死亡回合均值10.2；缺口中位：进攻+13.4/回合或防守+171.7有效血；敏感度：DPR+25%→0%，有效血+25%→0%（原始样本线性近似，仅诊断，不能排序；防守缺口未知0例）。

sign_audit.limits: Conditional simulation audit only. Missing attribution is not zero; unrecorded healing stays unknown. Not a calibration of real wins.

readiness.limits: Linear constant-rate approximation for diagnosis only, never ranking. Extra damage changes fight duration; extra HP ignores scaling and play order. Missing or censored samples are not losses. Monte Carlo intervals exclude model and calibration uncertainty.

build_ranking.limits: 同题同种子逐样本配对；先胜率、再合格S、最后配对掉血。只比较已模拟候选，未模拟选项保留未知；S不是胜率，缺口诊断不参与排序。大脑可偏离，但须说明理由。

adaptive.limits: Prefix replay only; no samples saved in shadow. S needs prefix sign/attribution and model trust gates. B2 wonLoss median retains its ordering but has no invented paired SE, so cannot eliminate. Whole-question admission requires independent offline and two-run natural coverage.
